Elias looked out at the empty horizon and understood, for the first time in thirty years, that he had never truly been alone either.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市褪去了白日的喧嚣，只剩路灯在雾气中晕出一圈圈昏黄。环卫工人挥动扫帚，沙沙声在空旷的街道上格外清晰。便利店的灯还亮着，像深海里的一座灯塔。偶尔有出租车驶过，车灯划破夜色，又迅速归于沉寂。高楼的窗户大多黑着，只有零星几扇还透出灯光——那或许是加班的人、失眠的人，或刚下夜班的人。远处传来第一班公交车的轰鸣，天边泛起一丝鱼肚白。这座城市在沉睡中缓缓翻身，即将醒来。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something is defined in terms of itself, like a story that contains a smaller copy of the same story inside it.\n• Imagine standing between two mirrors: you see a you, inside a you, inside a you — each reflection is a smaller version of the same thing.\n• In programming, a function calls itself on a smaller problem, and it needs a base case (a stopping point) so it doesn't go on forever — like Russian dolls that finally end with one tiny solid doll."}
